notes.title: UPDATE: Storyline
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34304032/b61252e611c4b10fdc4f5b228c6489249d73dc3d.jpg[/img]
We are glad to present another big update of Biathlon Battle VR. What points are included? 
[list][*] Storyline. Go from a novice biathlete to a champion.
[*] Awarding scene added. At the end of the Championship, you will find yourself in the hall at the award ceremony. Relive the emotions experienced by the athlete on the podium!
[*] Changing the design of info panels in the Menu location. The new design is made in the previously updated style of item information screens. The information screen now contains relevant information about game control:
- Trigger - grab an item / teleport;
- Left and Right Buttons on the Trackpad - turns on the spot;
- Button Menu - call the game menu during the race.
[*] Reset game progress for players who previously launched Biathlon Battle VR. This became a necessity when adding a storyline, as the equation of all players allowed to exclude possible bugs in one of the user groups.[/list]
Did you wait for the release of the storyline mode? Did it live up to your expectations? Write in the comments.

notes.title: UPDATE: Race UI and New Music
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34304032/24ff0f3c198e30f021a5691a0e9d78872d7565e6.jpg[/img]

We are working on game improvement. Introducing the new list of improvements:
[list] [*] [b]New design of race UI.[/b] We changed icons and added UI options depending on the selected race.
[*] [b]Trackpad buttons.[/b] We removed irrelevant functions to exclude their accidental call. Now, using the left and right buttons on the Trackpad, you can only turn around its axis. Nothing extra!
[*] [b]Updated the hand controller. [/b]Noticed that your "gaming" hands began to behave differently?
[*] [b]Added holographic pointers on tracks.[/b] Now, you definitely won’t pass the shooting range, because we added pointers!
[*] [b]New music tracks. [/b]Take a ski on the winter slopes with the breeze and with new music!
[*] [b]Fixed bug related to getting Steam Achievements.[/b]
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the updates. We look forward to your comments and feedback.

notes.title: GREAT UPDATE: Championship and Shop
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34304032/b4c4d2e276d86dd8c0d73566e43f117a3a86ef31.jpg[/img]

Ready to get a NEW biathlon experience? We worked a lot and... it is prepared to download! 

What is new?
[list][*] [b]Training Mode. [/b]More interesting, easier to learn. Don't ask "How to play" - just try our new Tutorial. 
[*] [b]Championship Mode. [/b]Take part in Championships, win the main golden cup and became the Champion of biathlon battles! 
[*][b] Shop.[/b] Won a money as a prize on Championship? It's time to spend them! Shop is a new location where you may spend your prize money on buying sports inventory. Get the best riffle and skis, get them all! 
[*] [b]Shooting Gallery. [/b]Try the rifle before buying! You may do it in the Shop. Just take the rifle by two hands and hit all targets. 
[*] [b]Differentiation of inventory. [/b]Different items - different parameters. Check the item's characteristics and choose the best. 
[*] [b]Added a lot of sounds.[/b] Clicks, item's fall sound, inventory sounds... Be sure, we added a lot because sounds make VR gaming more immersing. 
[*] [b]Two new localizations.[/b] Now players from France and German can play Biathlon Battle VR on their native languages. So, the game supports English, Chinese, Russian, France, and German.
[*] [b]Steam Achievements.[/b] Ready to test yourself? Try to get all of them!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34304032/7c5f1d67ee72b5e10eed1884eca8e52637671413.jpg[/img]

Did you try this? Sure, you have what to comment on. Send your comments and reviews.

notes.title: Update: A lot of the new content
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34304032/a54615fed170edd5f235cd051a8c6541c6d2a90e.jpg[/img]

We present a new update. What's in it?
[list]
[*] [b]Announced tracks added[/b]. Now you may race on three new locations. Ski near the wind turbines, meet the wonderful sunrise, ski downhill.
[*] [b]Additional routes on some tracks unlocked.[/b] Ride on skis on a new route to view old locations with a fresh eye. 
[*] [b]Stamina mechanic reworked. [/b]Learn how to manage stamina to reach the finish first. 
[*] [b]Opponents updated.[/b] Competing with artificial intelligence has become more difficult and ... more interesting.
[*] [b]Pause added. [/b]Now you can continue the race after the interruption without restarting and losing progress.
[*] [b]Settings appeared in the game menu. [/b]You can change the volume of music or sounds, as well as select the quality of the graphics in accordance with the performance of your PC.
[*] Great news to our Chinese users. [b]We added the Chinese language. You may change the language in the game.[/b] Click on the flag located on the table in the Menu. 
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34304032/dbbe734ce05b920493a4f0579aba80d299391d6b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34304032/843655eec3201fabbda3301ede004dc4d0e5c24b.jpg[/img]
Biathlon Battle VR was released three weeks ago. And all this time we have been working to improve our game. We received a lot of feedback that helped us identify the problems of the game and fix them.

Perhaps the main problem with the release version of the game was bad controls. The players did not understand how to turn in game. We have changed contols, now for turning it is enough to tilt the head or body in the right direction.
New controls is very convenient and allowed to move more maneuverable.

The second of the main problems was the main menu of the game. Now the player appears in front of an interactive table on which all menu items are conveniently located.

The third problem we consider the amount of content. We have added another new track, I made an overview post about it last week. The track is greatly improved visually relative to the screenshots you have seen. Also on the first track available from release, decorative assets were also changed.

And finally, we fixed a number of bugs we noticed during testing. Some of them allowed to increase the size of the rifles in the room to a gigantic size, as well as to fall out through the wall onto the street.

That's all for now, many more things will be refined and improved. We will share with you about our future development plans for the project in the following posts.
